title: Origins: Stardust
description: This mod adds a New Origin, Stardust!
body:
Stardust:

A being of an unknown origin in the cosmos, some say this being is just a random collection of matter, others say it's a living fragment of a star.

Powers:
Increased Thoughness - This being's body has adapted to be stronger than the average person, giving you more defense.
Cosmic Vision - When this being was adrift in space, they adapted to see in pure darkness.
Matter Flex - This being can flex and move its matter around to create a explosion.
Immune to Fire - During this being's space trip, they encountered cosmic radation that they adapted to, causing them to be immune to all fire damage.
Flight - This being's body has gained the ability to fly because of the shift in gravity.
Speed - Since this being is very light, it can move faster than the averger person.
Weightless - This being's body has adapted to space, making it nearly weightless, which means falling is no problem.
Translucent - This being, by nature, is partly translucent.
Lava Vision - This being can see in lava because of it's immunity to fire.
Fears - When this being is hit, they move their matter around to make themselves more resistant to damage.

Weaknesses:
End Fear - This being fears the end, for some unknown reason.
Limited Vitality - This being has less health than a normal person.
Invasive - As a being not born of this world, enities don't trust it.
Restless - This being can't sleep, possibly because the stars reminds it of it's old home.
Vegetarian - As a being that sees all life as equal, you can not bring yourself to eat animals.
Burning Water - Water washes this being's essence.

End Powers (Must have another player open portal for you):
When in the end, this being is closer to the universe than ever before, they gain Regeneration, Strength, Jump Boost, and luck, along with a twice the amount of hearts.

Night-time buffs:
Regeneragtion (Must be at full hunger)
Strength

Daytime power:
Solar Energy - absorb solar energy and release it in the form of an enderdragon's fireball.
